facts.fact: KRAY 在巴黎只要打一通国际电话，就能安排下一次会面。
facts.anchor: place an international phone call from Paris

facts.fact: 给海外 CIA 同僚打电话安排会面，被明确定义为一次“作战行动”。
facts.anchor: Phoning a fellow CIA officer overseas to set up a meeting is an operational act

facts.fact: 法国国内情报机构名为 DCRI，KRAY 绝不能进入它的监视雷达。
facts.anchor: the Direction Centrale du Renseignement Intérieur

facts.fact: KRAY 在给日内瓦的 VANDERROHE 打电话之前和之后都走反监视路线。
facts.anchor: KRAY employs Surveillance Detection Routes, SDRs, both before and after calling VANDERROHE in Geneva

facts.fact: 第一轮 SDR 途中，他在 tabac 用现金买了一张电话卡。
facts.anchor: While on his first Surveillance Detection Route, KRAY stops by a tabac and buys a phone card using cash

facts.fact: KRAY 自称 Howard 的朋友，问 VANDERROHE 次日下午十二点半是否方便。
facts.anchor: He asked me to check in and see if twelve thirty tomorrow afternoon works for you.

facts.fact: VANDERROHE 让 KRAY 转告 Howard：没问题，一切妥当。
通完电话他又做了两小时 SDR，只看到“幻影”和“路人”，没有认出“影子”。
facts.anchor: KRAY carries out two more hours of SDR, during which he spots no Shadows, only Figments and Casuals.
